records.description: Dedicated accommodation for specialist staff. The existing facility rule determines the added staffing capacity.
Additional space for keeping and managing draft beasts. Capacity changes follow the native upgrade definition.
Accommodation and facilities for a larger driver roster. Capacity is governed by the native upgrade.
Expanded shelter and storage for the stable's chariots. The native upgrade controls available capacity.
A working shop for the stable. Its existing upgrade provides a 10% discount on eligible mechanical services; it does not unlock new repair actions.
A dedicated treatment space. Its existing upgrade provides a 10% discount on eligible treatment services; treatment is available without this upgrade when other native conditions permit.
A practice ground for the stable. Its existing upgrade provides a 10% discount on eligible XP training, subject to the current training ceiling; it grants no automatic experience or attributes.
